name: Grilled aubergines with spicy chickpeas & walnut sauce
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical BBC Good Food / similar Turkish mezze-style recipes with 2 aubergines + 400g chickpeas serving 4 as a light main or substantial starter
Total time is sum of sequential steps (onion/chickpea sauce ~20 min + aubergine grilling ~10-15 min + sauce mixing ~5 min); parallel prep possible but conservatively totalled
No wheat, eggs, fish, shellfish, peanuts, soy or sesame listed or implied
Coriander, tomatoes, lemon, aubergine, chickpeas, spices and olive oil are compatible with all listed diets except where dairy conflicts
'Handful' coriander conservatively classified as leaves only (no stalks that might introduce ambiguity)
Red chilli assumed fresh, not a compound sauce
All gram weights from provided data used only for classification, not for yield or time
instructions:
step 1
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan, add the onion and fry until soft and lightly browned, about 10 mins. Add the chilli, ginger and spices and mix well. Stir in the chickpeas, tomatoes and 5 tbsp water, bring to the boil, then simmer for 10 mins. Add a little salt and pepper and the lemon juice.

step 2
Arrange the aubergines over a grill pan. Brush lightly with oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper, then grill until golden. Flip them over, brush again with oil, season and grill again until tender and golden.

step 3
Mix the yogurt with the garlic, most of the walnuts and coriander and a little salt and pepper. Arrange the aubergine slices over a warm platter and spoon over the chickpea mix. Drizzle with the walnut sauce and scatter with the remaining walnuts and coriander.

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 4 tbsp olive oil (standard 13.5g per tbsp; used in both onion/chickpea fry and aubergine brushing per instructions).

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium chopped onion, typical edible weight ~110g.

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 1 chopped red chilli, typical medium size ~45g.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: 2cm piece of ginger, typical peeled weight ~10g.

ingredients.name: Ground Cumin
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tsp ground cumin; standard density ~2g per tsp so 1g total.

ingredients.name: Chickpeas
ingredients.assumptions: 400g chickpeas, drained weight from standard can as used in recipe.

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.assumptions: 200g tomatoes (canned or fresh chopped per context).

ingredients.name: Lemon
ingredients.assumptions: Juice of 1/2 lemon; typical yield ~15-20g, using 15g.

ingredients.name: Aubergine
ingredients.assumptions: 2 medium aubergines; typical whole edible weight 300g each, total 600g (grilled with minimal oil already counted in pos 1).

ingredients.name: Walnuts
ingredients.assumptions: 25g walnuts (as measured; split between sauce and garnish per instructions).

ingredients.name: Coriander
ingredients.assumptions: Handful of coriander leaves; typical fresh herb handful ~10-20g, using 15g for both mixing and scattering.
